verses.restored: Unto thee, O YHWH, do I lift up my soul.

familiar.text: Unto thee, O LORD, do I lift up my soul.

modern.text: To You, O LORD, I lift up my soul;

original.text: לְדָוִ֡ד אֵלֶ֥יךָ יְ֝הוָ֗ה נַפְשִׁ֥י אֶשָּֽׂא

verses.restored: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

familiar.text: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

modern.text: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.

original.text: אֱֽלֹהַ֗י בְּךָ֣ בָ֭טַחְתִּי אַל אֵב֑וֹשָׁה אַל יַֽעַלְצ֖וּ אֹיְבַ֣י לִֽי

verses.restored: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

familiar.text: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

modern.text: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who are faithless without cause will be disgraced.

original.text: גַּ֣ם כָּל קֹ֭וֶיךָ לֹ֣א יֵבֹ֑שׁוּ יֵ֝בֹ֗שׁוּ הַבּוֹגְדִ֥ים רֵיקָֽם

verses.restored: Shew me thy ways, O YHWH; teach me thy paths.

familiar.text: Shew me thy ways, O LORD; teach me thy paths.

modern.text: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.

original.text: דְּרָכֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה הוֹדִיעֵ֑נִי אֹ֖רְחוֹתֶ֣יךָ לַמְּדֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

familiar.text: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

modern.text: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.

original.text: הַדְרִ֘יכֵ֤נִי בַאֲמִתֶּ֨ךָ וְֽלַמְּדֵ֗נִי כִּֽי אַ֭תָּה אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׁעִ֑י אוֹתְךָ֥ קִ֝וִּ֗יתִי כָּל הַיּֽוֹם

verses.restored: Remember, O YHWH, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

familiar.text: Remember, O LORD, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

modern.text: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.

original.text: זְכֹר רַחֲמֶ֣יךָ יְ֭הוָה וַחֲסָדֶ֑יךָ כִּ֖י מֵעוֹלָ֣ם הֵֽמָּה

verses.restored: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O YHWH.

familiar.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O LORD.

modern.text: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.

original.text: חַטֹּ֤אות נְעוּרַ֨י וּפְשָׁעַ֗י אַל תִּ֫זְכֹּ֥ר כְּחַסְדְּךָ֥ זְכָר לִי אַ֑תָּה לְמַ֖עַן טוּבְךָ֣ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Good and upright is the YHWH: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

familiar.text: Good and upright is the LORD: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

modern.text: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.

original.text: טוֹב וְיָשָׁ֥ר יְהוָ֑ה עַל כֵּ֤ן יוֹרֶ֖ה חַטָּאִ֣ים בַּדָּֽרֶךְ

verses.restored: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

familiar.text: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

modern.text: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.

original.text: יַדְרֵ֣ךְ עֲ֭נָוִים בַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וִֽילַמֵּ֖ד עֲנָוִ֣ים דַּרְכּֽוֹ

verses.restored: All the paths of the YHWH are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

familiar.text: All the paths of the LORD are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

modern.text: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.

original.text: כָּל אָרְח֣וֹת יְ֭הוָה חֶ֣סֶד וֶאֱמֶ֑ת לְנֹצְרֵ֥י בְ֝רִית֗וֹ וְעֵדֹתָֽיו

verses.restored: For thy name’s sake, O YHWH, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

familiar.text: For thy name’s sake, O LORD, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

modern.text: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.

original.text: לְמַֽעַן שִׁמְךָ֥ יְהוָ֑ה וְֽסָלַחְתָּ֥ לַ֝עֲוֺנִ֗י כִּ֣י רַב הֽוּא

verses.restored: What man is he that feareth the YHWH? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

familiar.text: What man is he that feareth the LORD? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

modern.text: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.

original.text: מִי זֶ֣ה הָ֭אִישׁ יְרֵ֣א יְהוָ֑ה י֝וֹרֶ֗נּוּ בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ יִבְחָֽר

verses.restored: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

familiar.text: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

modern.text: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.

original.text: נַ֭פְשׁוֹ בְּט֣וֹב תָּלִ֑ין וְ֝זַרְע֗וֹ יִ֣ירַשׁ אָֽרֶץ

verses.restored: The secret of the YHWH is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

familiar.text: The secret of the LORD is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

modern.text: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.

original.text: ס֣וֹד יְ֭הוָה לִירֵאָ֑יו וּ֝בְרִית֗וֹ לְהוֹדִיעָֽם

verses.restored: Mine eyes are ever toward the YHWH; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

familiar.text: Mine eyes are ever toward the LORD; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

modern.text: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.

original.text: עֵינַ֣י תָּ֭מִיד אֶל יְהוָ֑ה כִּ֤י הֽוּא יוֹצִ֖יא מֵרֶ֣שֶׁת רַגְלָֽי

verses.restored: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

familiar.text: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

modern.text: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.

original.text: פְּנֵה אֵלַ֥י וְחָנֵּ֑נִי כִּֽי יָחִ֖יד וְעָנִ֣י אָֽנִי

verses.restored: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

familiar.text: The troubles of my heart are enlarged: O bring thou me out of my distresses.

modern.text: The troubles of my heart increase; free me from my distress.

original.text: צָר֣וֹת לְבָבִ֣י הִרְחִ֑יבוּ מִ֝מְּצֽוּקוֹתַ֗י הוֹצִיאֵֽנִי

verses.restored: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

familiar.text: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

modern.text: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.

original.text: רְאֵ֣ה עָ֭נְיִי וַעֲמָלִ֑י וְ֝שָׂ֗א לְכָל חַטֹּאותָֽי

verses.restored: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

familiar.text: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

modern.text: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.

original.text: רְאֵֽה אוֹיְבַ֥י כִּי רָ֑בּוּ וְשִׂנְאַ֖ת חָמָ֣ס שְׂנֵאֽוּנִי

verses.restored: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

familiar.text: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

modern.text: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.

original.text: שָׁמְרָ֣ה נַ֭פְשִׁי וְהַצִּילֵ֑נִי אַל אֵ֝ב֗וֹשׁ כִּֽי חָסִ֥יתִי בָֽךְ

verses.restored: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

familiar.text: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

modern.text: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.

original.text: תֹּם וָיֹ֥שֶׁר יִצְּר֑וּנִי כִּ֝֗י קִוִּיתִֽיךָ

verses.restored: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

familiar.text: Redeem Israel, O God, out of all his troubles.

modern.text: Redeem Israel, O God, from all its distress.

original.text: פְּדֵ֣ה אֱ֭לֹהִים אֶת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל מִ֝כֹּ֗ל צָֽרוֹתָיו

translation_notes: This chapter expands corpus coverage while remaining explicitly pending a deeper Hebrew/source-witness audit. KJV is retained only as the familiar comparison layer.

The completion draft intentionally preserves coherent traditional English syntax where a verse has not yet received a curated Hebrew-sensitive rendering; it does not mix archaic and modern grammar. Major identified lexical/textual issues receive explicit overrides and notes.
safety_note: Confession must not be manipulated into shame, coercion, or blaming people for suffering.
source_witness_audit_flags: Compare directly with WLC/OSHB, Septuagint, Dead Sea Scrolls where extant, and other relevant witnesses during the global audit.
Preserve Psalm numbering and superscription differences across Hebrew and Greek traditions rather than silently harmonizing them.
